intended_chain.objective: Write a non-authoritative workflow routing index.
Publish and verify the task result, then perform packet-bound closure.

formula-intake-checkpoint: Writes /root/formula_workflow/intake_checkpoint.json containing source references (raw text from pdftotext, marker output directory) and inventories /root/latex_paper_marker/ as an active retention-review side file.
formula-extraction-note: Writes /root/formula_workflow/formulas_checkpoint.json with all extracted raw display-style formulas and /root/formula_workflow/status_normalization_note.json normalizing /root/latex_paper_marker/ from active to superseded after confirming complete formula capture.
formula-packet-binder: Writes /root/formula_workflow/formulas_draft.json (pending_publish formulas draft with cleaned and fixed formulas) and /root/formula_workflow/cleanup_packet.json binding /root/latex_paper_marker/ (status superseded, delete_after formulas_published) plus the intake_checkpoint.json recovery surrogate.
formula-finalizer: Publishes /root/latex_formula_extraction.md from the draft, runs minimal acceptance checks (all $$-wrapped, no duplicates, no empties), deletes the superseded /root/latex_paper_marker/ directory and the redundant /root/formula_workflow/intake_checkpoint.json surrogate, prints structured deletion confirmation JSON to stdout, and writes /root/formula_workflow/deletion_confirmation.json recording the removals.
